title: CI/CD & Continuous Delivery
blurb: How software gets from a commit to production safely and repeatedly: continuous integration, deployment pipelines, test strategy, release patterns, infrastructure as code, database change, branching, DORA metrics - then hands-on GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker, Argo CD and worked interview scenarios.
sources: Jez Humble & David Farley, Continuous Delivery (Addison-Wesley, 2010), ch. 1-15
Forsgren, Humble & Kim, Accelerate / DORA State of DevOps research (four key metrics)
Official docs: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Argo CD, Argo Rollouts, OpenFeature, Semantic Versioning, Conventional Commits, trunkbaseddevelopment.com
